name: Battery Level in Bounds
hint: Battery charge is represented as a percentage from 0 to 100, making energy-based decisions dependable.
instruction: Compare the battery reading with thresholds between 0 and 100, and handle values outside that interval explicitly.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@codeyB battery level :: sensing) < (20)> then
say [Low battery]
end
